author: IBM Technology
description:
Digital sovereignty gives your organization the ability to retain complete control and authority over your technology systems, data, operations, and AI. It’s a critical form of independence and autonomy in a complex regulatory landscape. Digital sovereignty is comprised of four pillars:

1️⃣ Operational sovereignty: maintain control over how your environments operate.
2️⃣ Data sovereignty: govern your data at rest, in use, and in motion.
3️⃣ Technology sovereignty: build on an open and modular architecture.
4️⃣ AI sovereignty: maintain control over where models run and how inference is governed.

#digitalsovereignty #aisovereignty #datasovereignty
